recentItems.title: GTA 6 Gameplay on Xbox Series X, Finally!
recentItems.description:
They can't hide it anymore. Every instance of GTA 6 footage up until now has all been on PlayStation consoles. Now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is available, we downloaded it on a Xbox Series X to see how it looks. Let the last thirteen years drift away behind you and soak in 20+ minutes of GTA 6 gameplay on Xbox Series X.

#IGN #XboxSeriesX #GrandTheftAutoVI

recentItems.title: GTA 6 Live AMA With Our Reviewer Who Played 120hrs
recentItems.description:
GTA 6 has launched in parts of the world and IGN is happy to reveal the review of the game. IGN Host Daemon Hatfield grills reviewer Luke Reilly in this AMA about his thoughts on GTA 6 and how it has or has not lived up to the massive hype surrounding it, and where it ranks in the series. If you have questions, we've got plenty of answers in this video!

#IGN #GTA6 #Gaming

recentItems.title: GTA 6 PS5 Pro Gameplay - 15 Minutes of The First Mission
recentItems.description:
While this may not be the very first minutes of Rockstar’s latest Grand Theft Auto, it is taken from the first proper mission of the game, which takes place after a short prologue. The reason for this? We think it would be nice for you to experience the start of the story for yourself, and it means we can avoid any potentially cool reveals or spoilers in that story-heavy prologue and focus on the gameplay itself.

In the roughly 15-minute section, you’ll see Jason, alongside his friends Cal and Donnie, complete a little drug-running operation near Key Lento — part of GTA 6’s fictional Florida Keys archipelago. You’ll get to check out just how stupidly gorgeous that water looks, a blend of both stealth takedowns and loud gunplay action, as well as some of that trademark Rockstar humour. Enjoy!

recentItems.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) Review
recentItems.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 reviewed by Luke Reilly on PlayStation 5. Also available on Xbox Series X|S.

"As optimistic as I was about a new GTA built in the wake of everything Rockstar learnt from the majestic Red Dead Redemption 2, I was simply not ready for just how much richer, deeper, and more satisfying Grand Theft Auto 6 has proven to be. After three weeks and over 120 hours playing it, I’m still hopelessly hooked, absorbing the world at walking speed like a tourist in a new town. I’m dazed by just how consistently I find myself noticing a new animation, unique pedestrian, or standout vehicle. I am completely enamoured with its series-best car handling and weaving through the realistically dense traffic. I am smitten with its spark-filled shootouts, potent explosions, and the brutal consequences of high-calibre exchanges. I am floored at how outright gorgeous the entire map is from any distance, and I am utterly gobsmacked at how beautifully lit it is at all times – especially dawn, dusk, and the dead of night. Exquisitely detailed, endlessly experimentable, and uncompromisingly engineered, GTA 6 has not stopped astonishing me since I started it. I regularly find myself in love with video games, but it’s extraordinarily rare that I find myself in complete awe of them. Put simply, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."

#ign #gta6 #grandtheftauto6

recentItems.title: How Long is GTA 6?
recentItems.description:
How long is GTA 6? Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and as expected, boasts a long story, with a ton of missions, side activities, and strangers to encounter, but just how long does it take to beat GTA VI? Here we’ll let you know exactly how many hours it took different members of the IGN team to finish Grand Theft Auto VI, and what they prioritised doing with that time. Here's how long to beat GTA 6!

Kamagi - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the exclusive gameplay trailer for KAMAGI, an upcoming single-player, third-person action game from Korean indie studio SODA Production. Reimagining Korean folk tales and creatures from traditional Korean folklore in a modern setting, KAMAGI features fast, precise parry-focused combat, challenging boss fights, and a distinctive visual style. "Kamagi" is an old Korean word for "crow." KAMAGI is in development for PC (Steam) and consoles, with a target release of March 2028.

recentItems.title: Giant Ojosama - Official Teaser Trailer (2027)
recentItems.description:
Check out the trailer for the upcoming anime, Giant Ojosama! The series is coming January 2027 to HIDIVE.
Oriko Fujido, heiress of Fujido Zaibatsu, the world’s largest beverage and vending machine company, was given a town as a present for her 4th birthday. Ever since, Oriko has worked hard to help the town grow with the help of her butler and researcher, Dr. Sebastian. Now, a little over 10 years later, the town is suddenly invaded by an enormous kaiju and the ever boastful Oriko declares she must protect it! To aid her, Dr Sebastian creates an experimental energy drink. Upon drinking it, Oriko grows almost instantly into a skyscraper-sized giant. However, in her zeal to protect the town and battle the kaiju invader, Oriko also unintentionally creates havoc!

recentItems.title: 3 Body Problem - Official Season 2 Teaser Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Season 2 Teaser Trailer for 3 Body Problem, the hit sci-fi action series distributed by Netflix. What's been watching comes to light in Season 2 of 3 Body Problem, streaming on January 14, 2027, on Netflix.

As the alien invasion nears, humanity prepares to meet them — on Earth and beyond.  While a space fleet embarks on a mission that spans centuries, a secret locked inside of one man's mind might be humanity's only hope for survival.

3 Body Problem stars Jess Hong, Benedict Wong, Eiza Gonzalez, Jovan Adepo, Saamer Usmani, Liam Cunningham, Marlo Kelly, Sea Shimooka, Claudia Doumit, Ellie De Lange, and more. The series is directed by Jeremy Podeswa (201, 202, 203), Miguel Sapochnik (204, 205, 206), and is written by David Benioff, D.B. Weiss, Alexander Woo (201), Rose Cartwright (202), Alexander Woo (203), Nichelle Tramble Spellman (204), David Benioff & D.B. Weiss (205, 206).

Season 2 of 3 Body Problem is streaming on January 14, 2027, on Netflix.
